dialogues.speaker: Yunus
dialogues.text: I'm the logistics officer for the Citadel of Regzar, responsible for the Corps of Thirty's supplies.

dialogues.speaker: Yunus
dialogues.text: Except for some mandatory Akademiya assignments, I delegate tasks to Mr. Effendi.

dialogues.speaker: Yunus
dialogues.text: If someone would help the Corps or residents nearby, I could pay for it with that portion of the fund.
